item.text: Thank you for watering the plants while I was away. The basil looks noticeably better, and I’m glad you gave it some attention. I also really appreciated you spotting the leaking window and letting me know right away. Putting a towel there was thoughtful and helpful, especially since I wasn’t around to deal with it. Thanks again for taking care of those small but important things.
